protocolPolicy: Protocol numbers are monotonic compatibility generations. Increment whenever a mod release requires a newer Bridge runtime contract or introduces an incompatible wire change; never reuse an older number.

protocols.description: V1.0 flat gameplay telemetry supported for backward compatibility.
V1.1 semantic l2Effect/r2Effect and schema-based settings telemetry.
V1.2 compatibility generation. Requires Bridge V1.4 while retaining semantic trigger payloads.
